jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator
Posted on 2 Nov 2026
Deadline on 29 Nov 2026

Description

Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi), a software company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, has been successfully providing software services since 2001 in global industry (USA, England, New Zealand, Asia and Africa). We have 280+ employees, with over 250+ skilled Software Engineers & SQA engineers. We continuously invest in hiring, developing, and retaining the best-in-class talents to leverage the latest technologies and offer the most advanced next-gen solutions to our clients. Some of our major projects and products include Nationwide Primary & Secondary Education ERP solutions for Bangladesh Government, Higher Education Management System running in 400+ US universities, Banking Compliance System running in 200+ financial institutions in the USA, 2021 BASIS National ICT Award winning ERP solution for container cargo management of private container yards. At DSi, we work to build state of the art next generation products with the industry's most talented resources.

We are seeking a highly organized and results-driven Project Coordinator to manage Government Software Projects from initiation to delivery. The ideal candidate will have a strong background & interest in software project management, excellent communication skills, and hands-on experience working with public sector clients, including ministries, government agencies, and state-owned enterprises is a plus.

Responsibilities

Project Management Support

Assist the Project Manager in planning, scheduling and tracking project activities against the contract milestones.
Maintain project trackers and logs for tasks, actions, issues and risks, and follow up with owners until items are closed.
Track due dates and alert the Project Manager before anything falls due.

Documentation and Reporting

Collect inputs from the team and compile them into periodic project reports to an agreed standard and format.
Draft official correspondence to the client and maintain an accurate record of what is sent and received.
Prepare meeting agendas, take minutes of internal and client meetings, circulate them and track decisions.
Maintain the project document repository, folder structure and version control.

Client and Stakeholder Coordination

Act as the day-to-day liaison with the client for scheduling, submissions and routine follow-up.
Coordinate training sessions, workshops and review meetings, including venue, materials, attendance sheets and certificates.
Follow up on pending client approvals, system access requests and clearance processes.

Governance and Compliance

Support project governance and review activities, and keep the project audit-ready.
Collect and organize evidence for internal and external quality, process and compliance reviews.
Ensure project documents follow the agreed house style, formats and templates.

Team Administration

Maintain the team roster, duty shifts and attendance records, and coordinate onboarding of new resources.
Coordinate access, workspace and logistics requirements for the on-site team.
Prepare presentations and status summaries for management and client briefings.
Requirements
2–4 years of experience in project coordination, project management support, business analysis or technical documentation, preferably on government or enterprise IT projects.
Strong written and spoken English and Bangla; able to draft formal correspondence to a government client without heavy editing.
Advanced MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable with Google Workspace and document version control.
Proven ability to compile structured reports from multiple team inputs under deadline.
Organized, detail-oriented and able to follow up persistently without supervision.
Willing to work on site at client premises in Dhaka as the project requires.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience on a government ICT project, especially with a procuring entity, donor-funded programme or a ToR-driven contract.
Familiarity with project management tools (MS Project, Jira, ClickUp, Asana) and diagramming tools (Draw.io, Lucidchart, Visio).
Exposure to software delivery processes: SRS, UAT, release and change management.
Awareness of CMMI, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 documentation and evidence practices.
Project management training or certification (CAPM, PMP, PSM or CSM) is an advantage.
Eligible to obtain security clearance where a client project requires it.

Education Qualification

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Benefits
Dynamic and modern work environment
Attractive salary
In-campus free lunch, snacks
Two festival bonuses
Yearly increments
Healthcare coverage
Company paid training, courses and certification

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Engineer
Posted on 12 Nov 2026
Deadline on 29 Nov 2026

Description

Dynamic Solution Innovators (DSi) has been working since 2001 as a Software Development Company globally. With offices in Bangladesh, USA and UK we have been providing high quality team augmentation and turn key project development services around the world.

We are looking for a Network Engineer who will be responsible for the design, implementation, administration, monitoring, and maintenance of secure, scalable, and highly available network infrastructure supporting the project. The incumbent will ensure optimal network performance, security, reliability, and compliance with organizational and project requirements while supporting mission-critical operations.

Responsibilities
Design, deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise-grade network infrastructure to support project operations.
Manage LAN, WAN, WLAN, SDN, and SD-WAN environments, ensuring optimal performance and availability.
Configure and administer routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VPN gateways, and other network security appliances.
Monitor network performance, capacity, utilization, and availability using appropriate monitoring and diagnostic tools.
Implement network security controls and ensure compliance with security policies, standards, and best practices.
Configure and manage routing and switching protocols, network segmentation, and secure remote access solutions.
Perform network troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex connectivity and performance issues.
Implement and maintain high-availability and redundancy mechanisms to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.
Collaborate with cybersecurity, systems, database, application, and cloud teams to ensure seamless integration of infrastructure components.
Maintain network documentation, architecture diagrams, configuration baselines, operational procedures, and disaster recovery plans.
Coordinate with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), vendors, and service providers for network-related services and support.
Participate in infrastructure planning, capacity management, risk assessment, and technology evaluation activities.
Requirements
Professional certifications (Minimum Professional Level such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIA, JNCIS-SEC, MTCRE, Fortinet NSE) are strongly preferred.
Proven expertise in designing, deploying, and managing large-scale network infrastructures.
Hands-on experience with SDN (Software-Defined Networking) and SD-WAN technologies.
Proficiency in networking protocols and services including TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, DHCP, VPN, 802.1X, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
Practical experience with routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and edge security appliances.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, including configuration and management of firewalls, IDS, IPS, and secure access controls.
Familiarity with network automation and scripting.
Experience with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.
Strong ability to troubleshoot complex network issues.
Proven experience in maintaining secure, high-availability networks.
Excellent communication skills for collaboration with cross-functional teams and service providers.

Professional Experience

10+ years in network administration with minimum 5 Years of Similar Nature Job Experience

Education Qualification

Bachelor's in Computer Science/ Information Technology, or related field

Benefits
Dynamic and modern work environment
Attractive salary
In-campus free lunch, snacks
Two festival bonuses
Yearly increments
Healthcare coverage
Company paid training, courses and certification

jobs.title: External Engagement Manager- General
jobs.description:

The role will support a predictable regulatory environment, strengthen the company’s reputation, and help protect and enable business growth.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and implement an external engagement strategy, building relationships with government stakeholders, policymakers, industry bodies, NGOs, and other key influencers.
- Shape advocacy initiatives that support a sustainable and predictable regulatory environment.
- Track political, regulatory, and legislative developments, and provide business leaders with strategic insights and recommendations.
- Represent the company in stakeholder discussions and industry forums to strengthen its reputation and influence.
- Lead stakeholder campaigns and policy initiatives addressing emerging business challenges and opportunities.
- Prepare advocacy materials, briefing documents, and position papers that explain complex issues clearly to different audiences.
- Work with cross-functional teams, regional colleagues, and global experts to deliver engagement strategies.
- Build and lead a high-performing team, developing talent and strengthening collaboration and stakeholder management capabilities.

## Requirements

- A degree in Political Science, Public Policy, Law, Economics, International Relations, Business Administration, or a related discipline is required.
- Candidates must have proven experience in government relations, public affairs, corporate affairs, external engagement, regulatory affairs, or stakeholder management.
- A strong understanding of political, legislative, and regulatory developments and their effects on business performance is required.
- Candidates must demonstrate the ability to influence senior external stakeholders and decision-makers and build trusted relationships.
- Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and campaign management skills are required.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills are essential, including the ability to turn complex issues into clear, persuasive messages.
- Candidates must have proven people leadership experience, including developing talent and leading high-performing teams.
- Resilience, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a rapidly changing external environment are required.

## Salary and benefits

- The role offers opportunities to influence policy discussions and stakeholder agendas, lead significant advocacy initiatives, and engage with senior leaders across government, industry, business associations, and international markets.
- Collaboration with local, regional, and global teams provides international exposure and opportunities to build a professional network.

- Its Global Returners program supports professionals returning after an extended career break, including time spent on family care, parental leave, national service, a sabbatical, or starting a business.

- Candidates who need reasonable adjustments or accommodations during recruitment are encouraged to notify BAT so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

jobs.title: Programme Head; Climate and Environmental Innovation Programme
jobs.description:
BRAC is seeking a Programme Head to lead its Climate and Environmental Innovation Programme (CEIP). The role provides strategic and technical direction for developing, testing, scaling, and embedding evidence-based climate and environmental solutions across BRAC programmes, enterprises, and external platforms.

## Responsibilities

- Lead CEIP’s strategy, technical teams, and innovation portfolio, ensuring scientific rigour, programme quality, coordinated delivery, organisational alignment, and measurable impact.
- Develop strategic priorities, intervention approaches, and delivery models for climate and environmental action.
- Direct the development, validation, transformation, and scaling of context-specific solutions in climate adaptation and mitigation, climate-resilient agriculture, water security, environmental management, Nature-based Solutions (NbS), low-carbon technologies, waste management, and the circular economy.
- Work with MF, BRAC Enterprises, IDP, UPG, ICCP, Aarong, and other BRAC platforms to integrate proven solutions into existing programmes and business models.
- Build partnerships with government agencies, universities, research institutions, businesses, development partners, and national and international networks.
- Represent BRAC in national, regional, and international forums and policy processes, strengthening CEIP’s technical credibility and influence.
- Lead evidence generation, validation, documentation, and sharing through publications, technical forums, policy engagement, and knowledge platforms to support replication, institutional agreement, and wider adoption.
- Oversee qualitative and quantitative monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks to assess effectiveness, outcomes, scalability, and impact.
- Identify emerging opportunities, develop innovative concepts, and engage partners and donors to strengthen the programme portfolio and financial sustainability.
- Identify opportunities for replication, institutional uptake, partnerships, funding, and wider scaling of proven BRAC solutions. Contribute to funding and partnership models that support long-term expansion.
- Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, succession planning, and capability development.
- Promote innovation, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, professional excellence, and effective teamwork across functions.
- Implement BRAC’s safeguarding policy throughout the programme and provide guidance and expertise to support a safe working environment.
- Ensure team members receive safeguarding training, support, and resources, and that identified issues are addressed according to safeguarding policies and procedures.
- Follow safeguarding reporting procedures for reportable incidents and encourage others to do the same.

## Requirements

- A master’s qualification is required.
- The experience requirement is listed as **10**, without a stated unit or further detail.
- Have strong strategic leadership, programme development, decision-making, analytical, problem-solving, and change management skills.
- Bring strong capabilities in innovation, research, evidence generation, and knowledge management.
- Demonstrate excellent partnership development, negotiation, networking, and stakeholder engagement skills.
- Have strong communication, presentation, advocacy, and policy influencing skills.
- Be able to develop innovative concepts, funding proposals, and sustainable business or financing models.
- Have advanced knowledge of climate change, environmental sustainability, adaptation, mitigation, resilience, and related development issues.
- Have strong knowledge of climate-resilient agriculture, water security, NbS, the circular economy, and low-carbon development.
- Understand climate policy, financing, innovation, research, and emerging global trends, alongside programme development, scaling, resource mobilisation, and partnership management.
- Demonstrate strategic vision, systems thinking, people development, collaboration, relationship building, and stakeholder influence.
- Show results orientation, accountability, adaptability, continuous learning, integrity, and commitment to sustainability and social impact.

Why is this role important to Field Nation?

The Sales Development Specialist plays an important role in generating new pipeline for Field Nation as part of our Sales Development team.

Initially, this role will focus primarily on converting inbound demand. You will often be the first person prospective buyers speak with, responsible for understanding their needs, determining fit, and connecting qualified opportunities with the appropriate sales team.

As Field Nation’s inbound process becomes more automated and streamlined, the role is expected to shift increasingly toward outbound prospecting and meeting generation. In that capacity, the focus will be on identifying and engaging prospective buyers, creating interest in Field Nation, and securing qualified meetings for our sales team. We’re looking for someone who can execute structured inbound qualification effectively today while bringing the confidence, persistence, and communication skills to proactively create new sales conversations over time.

You’ll work within established sales development processes and playbooks, independently managing your assigned responsibilities while receiving ongoing coaching to continue developing your skills. You'll collaborate closely with our U.S.-based Sales and Marketing teams and other Sales Development teammates to deliver a consistent, high-quality prospect experience and contribute to pipeline generation.

What you'll get to do:
INBOUND QUALIFICATION AND ENGAGEMENT

Lead qualification and discovery calls by phone and video meetings to understand prospective buyers’ business needs, urgency, and fit.

Serve as a first point of contact for inbound leads from marketing and other channels, responding with speed, curiosity, and professionalism.

Ask thoughtful questions to understand the work a prospect needs completed, including its scale, frequency, and how they get it done today.

Clearly articulate Field Nation’s marketplace model and value proposition to decision-makers and influencers.

Navigate buyer questions and objections while maintaining a productive conversation.

Identify qualified opportunities and route them to account executives with clear context and next steps.

Maintain accurate and timely activity tracking, notes, and lead statuses in Salesforce and other sales tools.

OUTBOUND PROSPECTING AND MEETING GENERATION

Take on increasing outbound prospecting responsibilities as the role evolves.

Research and prospect into defined accounts and audiences using phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.

Execute structured outreach sequences and messaging, tailoring outreach based on the account and prospect.

Use cold calling and other outreach to generate interest and secure meetings with prospective buyers.

Schedule qualified meetings directly with the appropriate sales team and provide clear context to support an effective first conversation.

PROCESS AND TEAM EXECUTION

Follow established qualification frameworks, call standards, workflows, and sales development playbooks.

Independently manage assigned leads, prospecting activities, follow-up and meeting generation while maintaining accountability for performance expectations.

Participate in ongoing coaching and skill development, applying feedback to strengthen qualification, objection handling, and prospecting effectiveness.

Recognize when buyer needs or qualification scenarios require additional guidance and collaborate with more experienced team members as needed.

Share insights from prospect interactions, including recurring questions and objections, to help improve messaging, targeting, outreach effectiveness, and the buyer experience.

Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teammates to support effective lead handoffs and follow-up.

Adapt to new tools, processes, and ways of working as the sales development function evolves.

Contribute to a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture.

2–4 years of sales development, inside sales, business development, or similar B2B sales experience supporting U.S, UK, or Australian markets.

Advanced English proficiency, both spoken and written, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently in live conversations with U.S. buyers.

Practical experience conducting B2B qualification/discovery calls, with the ability to ask relevant questions, understand business needs, and identify sales opportunities.

Demonstrated experience generating interest and securing meetings through outbound prospecting and cold calling.

A solid understanding of B2B sales fundamentals, qualification best practices, and structured sales processes.

The ability to handle common buyer questions and objections effectively, using active listening and sound judgment to guide conversations.

Familiarity with U.S. sales culture and buyer expectations.

Experience using CRM and sales productivity tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Confidence, curiosity, and initiative when engaging unfamiliar businesses and learning new use cases.

A coachable mindset and demonstrated ability to incorporate feedback to improve sales skills and results.

Strong attention to detail and accountability for accurate CRM documentation and follow-through.

The ability to independently manage daily responsibilities, prioritize competing demands, and adapt in a fast-paced environment across time zones.

Availability and willingness to work U.S. business hours.

Cybersecurity Expert
Job Type: Full time No. of Vacancies: 1 Experience: 3 Years
Apply Now

 

Job Context:

We are looking for a hands-on Cybersecurity Expert to take full ownership of information security at Riseup Labs. You will assess our infrastructure, close gaps, put practical controls in place, train our people, lead incident response, and support compliance with SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other frameworks. You will also act as a trusted security voice in client conversations and help grow our cybersecurity offerings.

This is an execution role. We need someone who implements and tests controls, not someone who only writes policies.

Job Responsibilities:

Security Assessment and Risk Management
Review infrastructure, networks, cloud environments, applications, devices, access controls, and internal practices to identify vulnerabilities and risks.
Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability assessments, risk assessments, and security reviews, and track findings through to remediation.
Maintain a risk register with clear priorities, owners, and timelines.
Security Governance and Controls
Establish and continuously improve company-wide security policies, standards, and controls.
Work with Technology, IT, DevOps, Compliance, HR, and Delivery teams so that controls are implemented and operating, not just documented.
Implement and manage security controls such as identity and access management, MFA, endpoint protection, logging and monitoring, patching, backup, and encryption.
Incident Response
Design and maintain an incident response plan, escalation matrix, and playbooks.
Lead investigation, containment, recovery, and post-incident reviews for security incidents.
Run incident-response tabletop exercises and drills.
Security Awareness and Training
Deliver regular security awareness training and workshops for all employees.
Plan and run phishing and social-engineering simulations and report on results and improvement.
Compliance and Assurance
Support SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other security and compliance requirements, including evidence collection, control testing, and audit readiness.
Map controls to relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls) and drive continuous improvement of our security posture.
Secure Development and DevSecOps
Partner with engineering and project teams on secure SDLC and security-by-design practices.
Support secure code review, threat modeling, SAST/DAST, dependency and container scanning, and secrets management in CI/CD pipelines.
Advise on securing cloud and AI platforms, APIs, and data pipelines.
Pre-Sales and Business Growth
Join client and pre-sales meetings to understand security requirements and respond to security questionnaires and RFPs.
Contribute to solution design and proposals with a security component.
Help define, package, and grow Cybersecurity as a service offering (e.g., assessments, VAPT, compliance readiness, security consulting).

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
3+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, information security, or security engineering.
Proven experience with vulnerability assessment and penetration testing, risk assessment, and security audits.
Strong knowledge of network security, application security, cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and identity and access management.
Practical experience with security tools such as SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, OpenVAS), Burp Suite, and Wireshark.
Hands-on experience with incident response and digital forensics fundamentals.
Working knowledge of SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, and NIST frameworks, with experience supporting at least one audit or certification.
Familiarity with secure SDLC, DevSecOps, and OWASP Top 10.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain security topics to technical and non-technical audiences, including clients and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, or cloud security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).
Experience with ISO 27001 implementation or PCI DSS assessment.
Experience in a software, IT services, or consulting environment.
Experience securing AI/ML platforms, APIs, and data pipelines.
Prior pre-sales, client-facing, or security consulting experience.
Experience with enterprise or government sector security requirements in Bangladesh.
Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for security automation.

Key Competencies

Ownership and accountability.
Hands-on, execution-focused approach.
Risk-based thinking and sound judgment.
Cross-functional collaboration.
Teaching and communication skills.
Client confidence and professionalism.
Ability to work calmly under pressure during incidents.
